messages:
alex: Quick rotation handoff — sharing a compact status + blockers + CR pings. TL;DR: dry-run results showed two KMS grant failures and one audit perm drift. Details below.

maria: What I did: ran overnight KeyAudit v2 across dev/staging vaults, fixed 3 permission mismatches, opened PR #789 to align policies. Blockers: need cross-account role approval for staging -> prod smoke. Today: re-run after approvals and kick prod dry-run.

jen: On it, will review PR #789 in ~1h. Quick note: prod IAM role name changed last week, might need to update the tf module naming. :eyes:

sam: Dry-run rotation on staging completed but rotation-broker errored when updating KMS grants. Error snippet: 
```
2026-03-16T22:14:03Z ERROR grant update failed: AccessDenied: User not authorized to perform: kms:PutGrant on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345
```
Looks like the grant principal is the old service account. CC @leo (infra).

leo: I saw that earlier in the afternoon — policy still references svc-account-legacy. I'll open a small patch to update the principal and add an integration test to validate PutGrant perms. ETA ~2 hrs. For prod we should plan a short maintenance window.

maria: Noted. PR #789 also shifts the vault rotation window to low-traffic hours. Anyone object to delaying prod rotation by 2 hrs to avoid overlap with batch jobs? :thumbsup:

alex: No objections. @rotation-bot, please schedule the dry-run for 2026-03-17 02:30 UTC and notify on-call.

rotation-bot: Rotation dry-run scheduled by alex for 2026-03-17T02:30:00Z. Notifying on-call.

jen: Reviewed PR #789 — left two tiny nits (naming + inline comment). Otherwise LGTM. @maria please address and I'll merge.

maria: Fixed both nits and pushed. Ping for merge.

alex: Quick CR queue check — eng-releases has a blocking deploy that depends on the infra patch. @leo can you prioritize that after the KMS principal fix?

leo: Yep, I'll bump the infra PR after the principal patch lands. Should be cleared in ~3 hrs.

sam: One follow-up ask: can we add a post-rotation smoke-check to verify tokens decrypt correctly? Suggest adding this command to the playbook:
```bash
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://token.enc --key-id alias/redwood-prod
```
Also add expected output and common fail reasons to runbook.

alex: Good call — add the smoke-check to the rotation playbook and runbook. @jen can you add a short paragraph to the runbook with the command and troubleshooting tips, then I'll sign off.

jen: Added the step to the runbook and opened PR #790. Included expected failure cases and retry notes.

alex: Awesome. Anything else before I close this handoff in ~6 hrs?

maria: Nothing else from my side. :white_check_mark:

leo: I'll post progress in this thread after the principal patch.

sam: I'll monitor the rotation-broker logs during the dry-run and post any anomalies.

alex: Thanks all — will follow up after the dry-run.
